source_notes.name: boutique-skills-20260802-review
source_notes.description: 复核 boutique-skills 仓库 2026-08-02 新增内容，筛选对视频生成和自媒体运营有价值的标准 Skill、套件及待封装项目。

policy.promotion_rule: Only promote a video skill after SKILL.md or README has been reviewed, runtime outputs are constrained to ~/Desktop/自媒体创作, and a concrete Newma caller exists.

repositories.name: video-use
repositories.role: conversation-driven raw-footage-to-final-video editor
repositories.notes: Do not replace FunASR or Jianying paths. Useful for folder input, EDL thinking, and one-shot final.mp4 workflow design.

repositories.name: freecut
repositories.role: video-use fork with local Whisper/VibeVoice-ASR instead of paid ElevenLabs
repositories.notes: Better first test target than upstream video-use if avoiding new paid ASR/TTS dependencies.

repositories.name: talking-head-editor
repositories.role: 8-step talking-head editing pipeline
repositories.notes: No top-level SKILL.md and no license found during check; use as process reference only.

repositories.name: caption-clip
repositories.role: Deepgram transcription, SRT cleanup, styled subtitle burn-in with FFmpeg
repositories.notes: Deepgram should remain optional. Default Newma path stays FunASR/Jianying/Agent proofread.

repositories.name: claude-shorts
repositories.role: longform-to-shortform extraction, highlight scoring, vertical caption rendering
repositories.notes: Should run after main video completion as secondary distribution, not inside primary video generation.

repositories.name: video-wrapper
repositories.role: variety-show style visual wrappers for interview and podcast videos
repositories.notes: Strong candidate for lower-third, term-card, quote-callout, social-bar, chapter-title template ideas.

repositories.name: remotion-video-skill
repositories.role: programmatic Remotion video generation with TTS and templates
repositories.notes: Newma already depends on html-video, Remotion, GSAP, and OpenAI Remotion skill. Avoid duplicate runtime dependency.

repositories.name: text-to-lottie
repositories.role: Agent-authored Lottie/Bodymovin JSON with local Skia Skottie player verification
repositories.notes: Use for transparent stickers, lower thirds, warning/status icons, document scan cues, data-flow arrows, market ticker accents, chapter/outro marks. Never use it to replace real data charts, tables, screenshots, or sourced evidence.

repositories.name: claude-real-video
repositories.role: local video reading: scene-aware keyframes, deduplicated frames, contact sheets, transcript, audio and MANIFEST for LLM review
repositories.local_install_note: Cloned in the project reserve on 2026-07-24, HEAD e34161691c9e; isolated Python 3.11 .venv installed with the fast extra.
repositories.notes: Default local video reading layer for reference videos and finished-cut audits. Newma wrapper is scripts/read_video_with_crv.py and stores outputs under ~/Desktop/自媒体创作, never in skills or project root.

repositories.name: product-launch-video-skill
repositories.role: cinematic product launch videos with Remotion
repositories.notes: Useful only for product launch/demo channels; not a core finance article/video dependency.

repositories.name: claude-code-video-toolkit
repositories.role: AI-native video production toolkit with templates and examples
repositories.notes: Retain as a local reference for Remotion templates, transitions, reusable components, data visualization and browser recording. Do not register its Modal, RunPod, ElevenLabs, R2 or other third-party cloud routes.

repositories.name: ian-xiaohei-illustrations
repositories.role: minimal hand-drawn conceptual illustration grammar for article and video inserts
repositories.local_install_note: Cloned in the project reserve on 2026-07-24, HEAD 91b560849e8f. Review prompt/style changes before updating the local adapter.
repositories.notes: Do not vendor or edit upstream. Newma replaces the recurring character with the serious lemon-person IP and uses this only for conceptual metaphors, transitions, workflows, and emotional beats. It never replaces real charts, tables, documents, screenshots, or sourced evidence.

repositories.name: seedance2-skill
repositories.role: official Seedance/Jimeng prompt design for generated short B-roll and animated cutaways
repositories.notes: Keep model access as an allowed optional dependency. Never use synthetic footage to impersonate factual evidence.

repositories.name: hyperframes
repositories.role: HTML and GSAP video compositions with timed captions, overlays, transitions, and rendering CLI
repositories.notes: Available through the installed HyperFrames plugin. Keep Newma scene plans and evidence gates as the source of truth.

repositories.name: auto-editor
repositories.role: automatic silence and pacing cleanup for audio and video
repositories.notes: Do not replace the reviewed FunASR or Jianying routes. Evaluate deletion naturalness and semantic safety before promotion.

repositories.name: chengfeng-videocut-skills
repositories.role: local-first video editing agent skill collection
repositories.notes: Review license and runtime boundaries before any production trial. External output remains subject to Newma QC.

repositories.name: social-auto-upload
repositories.role: multi-platform video upload automation
repositories.notes: Canonical runtime metadata remains in configs/publish/upstream_repos.json. Final publication always requires explicit current-session confirmation.

repositories.name: video-editing-pipeline
repositories.role: roughcut pipeline and EDL timeline generation
repositories.notes: XHS screenshot confirms the label but this check did not locate a stable GitHub owner/repo.

repositories.name: ffmpeg-usage
repositories.role: FFmpeg utility recipes for transcoding, merging, clipping, audio extraction, subtitle burn-in
repositories.notes: Keep FFmpeg as a direct external tool and document recipes in existing skills.

repositories.name: video-shotcraft
repositories.role: cinematic Remotion shot-recipe library with real-page capture, 2.5D camera motion, beat-synced editing and sound design
repositories.notes: The dasheng-vox-skills adapter now validates card/style/demo bindings and locks selected scenes to local Remotion. Keep Newma narration, evidence, real-footage and aspect-ratio rules as the governing contract.

repositories.name: gsap-skills
repositories.role: official GSAP suite for core tweens, timelines, React/framework integration, ScrollTrigger, plugins, utilities and performance
repositories.notes: Expose one director-facing suite and dispatch internally. This keeps the registry readable and avoids eight nearly identical top-level advisors competing with existing animation skills.

repositories.name: impeccable
repositories.role: frontend and HTML visual audit, responsive polish, motion review and browser-based quality assurance
repositories.notes: Use for storyboard HTML, dynamic charts, title systems and browser acceptance. It complements design-taste-frontend and review-animations rather than replacing either.

repositories.name: taste-skill
repositories.role: anti-slop art direction, visual hierarchy and layout quality guidance
repositories.notes: Already installed as design-taste-frontend. Do not create a second copy from boutique-skills.

repositories.name: video-autopilot-kit
repositories.role: short-video scripting, CapCut JSON handoff, FFmpeg templates and batch production
repositories.notes: Do not advertise as an installed Skill. Clone and review the CapCut schema, output boundaries and batch behavior, then wrap it with a guarded Newma adapter and smoke test before routing.
